sources.name: myScheme
sources.authority: National e-Governance Division / Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.scope: Central and State/UT scheme discovery, personalized screening, scheme detail pages and official application link-outs
sources.access_and_reuse: Public browsing and official hyperlinks are supported subject to the URL-hosting terms. Do not frame, shorten or imply endorsement. No unrestricted public data API was verified; seek documented authorization/API access.
sources.update_observation: Portal reports continuous onboarding; About/FAQ pages showed Last Updated 20 August 2026.
sources.recommended_use: Primary national discovery and secondary cross-check; never override a newer scheme-owner source.

sources.name: National Portal of India - Schemes
sources.authority: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.scope: Government scheme and service directory, official links, health and wellness discovery
sources.access_and_reuse: Use public pages for discovery and linking. The portal states content is owned by the respective ministries/departments; confirm material rules with them.
sources.update_observation: Pages display reviewed/updated timestamps; scheme search content may be sourced from myScheme.
sources.recommended_use: Secondary discovery, official directory and source cross-check.

sources.name: National Health Authority - PM-JAY
sources.authority: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.scope: PM-JAY program definition, entitlement basis, benefit cover, portability and coverage features
sources.access_and_reuse: Public informational source. Link and cite; use beneficiary systems only through authorized access.
sources.update_observation: NHA pages are actively maintained; material rules must be versioned and rechecked monthly.
sources.recommended_use: Primary source for PM-JAY structured program facts.

sources.name: PM-JAY Beneficiary Identification System / Ayushman beneficiary portal
sources.authority: National Health Authority and State Health Agencies
sources.scope: Search existing entitled-family list, authenticate family membership, e-KYC and Ayushman Card
sources.access_and_reuse: Authenticated official system. Do not scrape, store credentials or automate without a documented NHA/SHA integration agreement.
sources.recommended_use: Only source in this package permitted to promote PM-JAY from screened/relevant to officially verified, subject to authorized response evidence.

sources.name: PM-JAY Hospital Empanelment Management
sources.authority: National Health Authority and State Health Agencies
sources.access_and_reuse: Use public/provider information only as allowed; no open bulk API was verified.
sources.update_observation: Operational registry; provider status can change and should be checked at time of referral.
sources.recommended_use: Confirm PM-JAY network status; do not confuse with ABDM HFR registration.

sources.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission
sources.scope: ABHA identity, consented health-record exchange and digital-health ecosystem
sources.access_and_reuse: Sandbox and production integrations require onboarding/approval; health data access requires consent and security compliance.
sources.update_observation: Versioned sandbox documentation and platform releases.
sources.recommended_use: ABHA identity and health-record interoperability only; never infer health-scheme eligibility.

sources.name: ABDM Health Facility Registry
sources.scope: Updated comprehensive registry of verified health facilities across systems of medicine
sources.access_and_reuse: Use through documented ABDM onboarding/sandbox. Registry presence is not PM-JAY empanelment.
sources.update_observation: Operational registry; verify facility status near time of use.
sources.recommended_use: Facility identity, type and address; join separately to scheme-specific network status.

sources.name: National Health Mission
sources.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.scope: Maternal, newborn, child, adolescent, communicable and non-communicable health program pages and guidelines
sources.access_and_reuse: Public pages and PDFs can be cited and linked. Check copyright policy before reproducing entire works.
sources.update_observation: Portal displayed updated date 20 August 2026; guideline updates are notification-driven.
sources.recommended_use: Primary rules and service-entitlement source for JSY, JSSK, RBSK and maternal/child programs.

sources.name: MoHFW and Directorate General of Health Services
sources.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / DGHS
sources.scope: National programs, technical guidance and citizen service information
sources.access_and_reuse: Public official material; link/cite and retain exact page/document version. Program-specific systems govern transactions.
sources.update_observation: Program pages and guidelines are updated irregularly; monitor change hashes.
sources.recommended_use: Primary program/service descriptions and controlling guidance where available.

sources.name: SPNIWCD PMMVY information and FAQ
sources.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
sources.scope: PMMVY eligibility categories, benefit milestones, documents, application and official portal
sources.access_and_reuse: Public official information. Application/approval remains in the PMMVY portal and State Nodal Officer process.
sources.update_observation: Page showed last update 25 August 2026; monitor FAQ and documents page monthly.
sources.recommended_use: Primary PMMVY structured-rule and document source.

sources.name: Maharashtra Public Health Department
sources.scope: State health schemes/programs, government orders, facilities, helplines and grievances
sources.access_and_reuse: Website policy requires permission for reproduction, accurate use and prominent acknowledgement; link to official originals.
sources.update_observation: Active 2025-2026 pages; schemes and helplines should be reviewed monthly.
sources.recommended_use: Primary Maharashtra policy, service, helpline and state-program source.

sources.name: National Health Mission Maharashtra
sources.scope: Maharashtra implementation of maternal, child, tribal and national health programs
sources.access_and_reuse: Public official source; cite/link and apply Government of Maharashtra website policies.
sources.update_observation: Many scheme pages dated April 2025; recheck against new orders and NHM PIPs.
sources.recommended_use: Primary state implementation source for ASHA workflows and local access.

sources.name: State Health Assurance Society Maharashtra
sources.scope: Governance and official contact for integrated MJPJAY/PM-JAY assurance
sources.access_and_reuse: Use official channels and approved integration for beneficiary/network data.
sources.update_observation: Operational authority; contact and rules can change.
sources.recommended_use: MJPJAY official escalation and verification authority.

sources.name: API Setu
sources.authority: NeGD / Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.scope: Directory and controlled access to documented government APIs
sources.access_and_reuse: Valid credentials and authorized, documented use are required. Availability is issuer and API specific.
sources.update_observation: API directory and documentation are versioned by publishers.
sources.recommended_use: Preferred route for any documented government API; absence from the directory means do not invent an API.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform India
sources.scope: Published non-sensitive datasets, resources and APIs
sources.access_and_reuse: Dataset-specific terms and metadata apply; non-sensitive open data may be reusable under the published license.
sources.recommended_use: Facilities and aggregate analytics only unless an authoritative dataset explicitly supports another use.

sources.name: Chief Minister Relief Fund Maharashtra
sources.scope: Medical-assistance application materials, hospital list and application status
sources.access_and_reuse: Use official application/status pages; do not automate applicant data without authorization and consent.
sources.update_observation: Operational portal; procedure and assistance amounts are decision/version dependent.
sources.recommended_use: Discovery and assisted application. Keep deterministic eligibility disabled until the current controlling procedure is reviewed.
